newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson in supply deal with Europolitan.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson in supply deal with Europolitan.

text.p: Swedish telecommunications company LM Ericsson AB on Tuesday said it had signed a supply contract with mobile telephone operator Europolitan until 2000.
Ericsson said the agreement was for deliveries for radio base stations as well as operation and maintenance systems.

"The agreement, which is the first in this area between Ericsson and Europolitan, means that Europolitan engages Ericsson as a new supplier of equipment for the Europolitan mobile network," Ericsson said in a statement.
Europolitan is a cellular operator with licences for GSM and DCS 1800 networks.
Its GSM network started operations in 1992 and at the end of September, 1996, it was serving 241,000 subscribers.
Europolitan's parent company is Nordictel Holding AB .
